svg.text: From a customer arriving, to an agent acting, to an auditor asking for proof. The whole product in one picture.
ACT 1 · GETTING STARTED — day one to week two
Wrap the agent with the MCP wrapper,
or add the SDK. No code rewrite.
Runs on a laptop or in the cluster.
What agents exist, who owns them,
what each one can actually reach.
The first thing an auditor asks.
ACT 2 · WHAT HAPPENS ON EVERY SINGLE ACTION — forever, in under 10 ms
a customer ticket, a scheduled job,
a user asking the agent to do something
It wants to call a tool — read a record,
send an email, run a query, move money.
We assume this decision may already be poisoned.
Verified identity, not a shared API key.
Delegation chain resolved — who asked for this.
Is it allowed to do this?
Plain rules, evaluated outside the model.
Checks the tool, the arguments, the budget,
and what this session has already touched.
Does this look like an attack?
leaving in the payload. Backup, not the main lock.
Every answer, including the boring ones, becomes a
signed record nobody can quietly edit later.
The tool executes. Anything it returns is labelled with where it came from.
Secrets stripped, an amount capped, a field removed. The agent still gets an answer.
Executes where it cannot cause harm. Results marked untrusted.
Held. A named person sees the real action, not the agent's summary.
The agent gets a clear refusal and the reason. Nothing reached the world.
Slack or SIEM if it mattered. Budgets tick down. Baselines update.
ACT 3 · WHAT THE CUSTOMER ACTUALLY GETS
A live view of what every agent is doing
right now, and what was stopped.
An alert, then one button to revoke
Replay the whole session step by step.
See exactly what the agent saw,
decided and did. Not a guess.
An evidence pack that proves nothing
was deleted — mapped to EU AI Act,
The promise in one line: every action an agent takes is checked before it happens, and every decision can be proved afterwards.
